issues.jp_before: 母[はは]{の|no-possessive}誕生日[たんじょうび]{に|ni-time}、私[わたし]{は/が|wa-topic}母[はは]{に|give-ageru}花[はな]{を|o-object}あげました。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of line 1 (I gave my mother flowers) and line 18 (Mother's Day carnations to mother); redundant repetition of 母.
issues.action: Rewrote as 卒業[そつぎょう]{の|no-possessive}とき、私[わたし]{は/が|wa-topic}後輩[こうはい]{に|give-ageru}制服[せいふく]{を|o-object}あげました。 with new English, f=2, lv=3.

issues.jp_before: 弟[おとうと]{に|give-ageru}あげるおもちゃ{は/が|wa-topic}どこ{に|ni-location}ありますか。
issues.problem: が listed as an alternative, but in a direct 'where is X?' question X takes は; おもちゃがどこにありますか is unnatural as a direct question.

issues.jp_before: 先生[せんせい]{は/が|wa-topic}学生[がくせい]{に|give-ageru}シール{を|o-object}あげました。
issues.problem: 学生 suggests university students; a teacher handing out stickers implies school pupils (生徒).
issues.action: Replaced 学生[がくせい] with 生徒[せいと].

issues.jp_before: クラスメート{に|give-ageru}ノート{を|o-object}あげ{たら|tara-conditional}、とても喜[よろこ]んでくれました。
issues.problem: English 'gave a classmate my notes' implies lending or sharing notes, which あげる (give away) does not convey; ノートをあげる means giving a notebook.
issues.action: Changed English to 'When I gave a classmate a notebook, they were very pleased.'
